text:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a burst of apiserver leader elections in eu-west1 and intermittent packet loss to etcd replicas. apiserver p99 latency ~400ms and GPU provisioning queues piling up. Anyone else?
kevin: Yep, ~6 leader flips in the last 10m. controller-manager restarted on 2 pods. Logs show `etcd: read timeout` and a bunch of `watch closed` traces.
jia: CNAT metrics show increased 502/504 between apiserver and etcd endpoints. Could be SNAT/conntrack exhaustion on the NAT nodes — neteng?
amar: If we divert traffic to another region (us-west) we'll start spinning GPUs and that will blow the burst budget. We should consider throttling non-critical controllers first.
maya: Agreed @amar. Proposal: lower controller-manager concurrency for non-prod controllers in eu-west1 and pause GPU autoscale for the burst pool for 1–2h. Also roll a conservative fallback policy for routing.
kevin: Quick data check:```
kubectl get events -n kube-system --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 50
```lots of `connection refused` and `dial tcp` snips.
sre-bot: Incident alert — apiserver latency > 300ms (eu-west1) for 8 minutes. Paging eng-sre.
jia: I'm going to patch conntrack timeouts on the NAT boxes and free stale entries. Coordinating with neteng now. ETA ~15m.
amar: I'll temporarily scale down the GPU burst pool to 50% (manual) to reduce new node attaches — short term saves ~$2k/day but increases provisioning latency. Thoughts?
kevin: Applied a canary — reduced controller-manager concurrency in eu-west1 to 5 for the big controllers. Leader flips dropped to 1 in 10m and watch errors decreased.
maya: Latency improving to ~120ms. Good catch. Follow-ups: check etcd fd limits, nvme IO on replicas, and whether keeper timeouts are tuned.
jia: Opening INC-4572 for tracking and postmortem if threshold crossed. Adding relevant logs/graphs and the conntrack patch notes: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4572
maya: :thumbsup: I'll keep GPU autoscale paused for 2h and monitor. If anything regresses, ping me @kevin or @jia.
kevin: Will monitor leader election count and apiserver histograms. Also adding a short runbook note for quick conntrack cleanup next time.
maya: Thanks team — looks like mitigation worked. We'll reconvene in the postmortem to discuss longer-term fixes (routing redundancy, NAT pool sizing, and controller backpressure).
